local.deviceOnly: These settings apply only to this device/browser.
local.localLabelHelp: Display a colored banner at the top of the page to identify this instance.
local.distanceUnitsHelp: Controls how distances are shown throughout the app.
local.reopenLastHelp: Opens the last channel or contact when the app starts.
local.autoFocusHelp: Place the cursor in the message input when switching conversations. Desktop only.
local.batteryPercentHelp: Shows the radio’s battery percentage in the status badge.
local.batteryVoltageHelp: Shows the radio’s battery voltage in the status badge.
local.statusDotPulseHelp: Flashes the status dot as packets arrive, in a color per packet type.
local.richPayloads: Render MeshCore Open reactions as emoji
local.richPayloadsHelp: Shows the emoji reactions sent by MeshCore Open as emoji instead of code.
local.pathHopWidthHelp: Adds the hop width to the hop count of received messages, such as (2 · 2B).
local.textReplaceHelp: Replaces text as you type a message. Write the pairs as a JSON object.
local.textReplaceUnsaved: {{error}} Changes are not saved until this is resolved.
local.fontSizeHelp: Text size in this browser, from 25% to 400%.

preview.intro: Preview alert, message, sidebar, and badge contrast for the selected theme.
preview.connected: Connected preview: radio link healthy and syncing.
preview.infoAlert: Info: channel slot cache refreshed from radio.
preview.errorAlert: Error: post-connect setup timed out. Reboot the radio and restart.

notifications.thisDeviceHelp: Get notifications on this browser, even when it is closed.
notifications.thisDeviceGlobalHelp: Every subscribed browser gets the same rules.
notifications.unsupported: Push notifications are not supported by this browser.
notifications.needsHttps: Push notifications need HTTPS. Open Meshloom over HTTPS to turn them on.
notifications.defaultsHelp: Choose where each event is sent. Telemetry alerts are set on the Alerts page.
notifications.newContactHelp: Notify when a companion contact is first seen. Either this toggle or Companion advertisements is enough.
notifications.newDmHelp: Notify on incoming direct messages and room-server posts, unless a conversation exception overrides it.
notifications.advertRepeaterHelp: Notify when a repeater is first seen on the mesh.
notifications.advertCompanionHelp: Notify when a companion node is first seen. Either this toggle or New contacts is enough.
notifications.advertSensorHelp: Notify when a sensor is first seen on the mesh.
notifications.channelFoundHelp: Notify when a new hashtag channel is found. Conversation exceptions do not apply.
notifications.telemetryAlertHelp: Notify when a tracked telemetry reading raises an alert. Conversation exceptions do not apply.
notifications.ossUpdateHelp: Notify when a Meshloom update is available for this node.
notifications.exceptionsHelp: Settings for one conversation, set from the bell in its header.
notifications.vapidSubjectHelp: A contact for push services: mailto:you@domain.tld or https://your-host. Apple needs a real address.
notifications.vapidSubjectInvalid: Must be empty, a mailto:you@domain.tld, or an https://host origin (no path).

radio.disconnectHelp: Stops reconnecting, so another device can use the radio.
radio.pathHashHelp: 2 bytes is the default. With 1 byte, repeaters get mixed up more often on a busy mesh.
radio.pathHashUnavailable: The radio did not report this setting. Reconnect it; if this message stays, update its firmware.
radio.pickOnMap: Choose a location on the map
radio.pickOnMapHelp: Click the map to place the pin, then save to fill the latitude and longitude fields.
radio.pickOnMapCenteredCurrent: Centered on the current radio location.
radio.advertLocationHelp: Adds your radio’s position to its adverts. With Community on, Community then gets the exact position instead of an approximate one.

firmware.title: Firmware settings
firmware.loadFailed: Could not read the firmware settings
firmware.saveFailed: Could not save the firmware setting
firmware.unsupported: This firmware does not report any settings.
firmware.empty: The radio reports no setting. To use a GPS, plug it in before turning the radio on.
firmware.gpsHelp: When on, the radio uses the GPS for its position and sets its clock from it.

selfTelemetry.title: Radio sensors
selfTelemetry.intro: What the radio reports about itself.
selfTelemetry.loadFailed: Could not read the radio sensors

factoryReset.title: Factory reset
factoryReset.intro: Erases everything on the radio, to start over or hand it on.
factoryReset.needsRadio: Connect the radio to use this.
factoryReset.dialogIntro: Erases the radio’s identity, contacts, channels and settings, for good. Your messages in Meshloom are kept.
factoryReset.confirmLabel: Type the radio name to confirm: {{name}}
factoryReset.sent: The radio is resetting and Meshloom will reconnect by itself. Then set the radio parameters again in the Radio tab.

radio.telemetrySharingHelp: Who may read this radio’s telemetry.
radio.rebootHelp: Some settings may require a reboot to take effect on some radios.
radio.exportHelp: Export saves the settings to a file. Import applies a file and restarts the radio.
radio.multiAcksHelp: The radio sends an extra receipt for the direct messages it receives.
radio.autoResendHelp: Resends a channel message once when no repeater picked it up. It never creates a duplicate.
radio.floodScopeHelp: Keeps your messages to the repeaters of one region, such as MyRegion. Leave empty for no region.
radio.knownRegionsHelp: One region per line, so received messages show their region’s name.
radio.discoverRegionsHelp: Asks nearby repeaters which regions they use, to fill the list above.
radio.maxContactsHelp: How many contacts Meshloom loads onto the radio. Favorites come first.
radio.maxContactsWarn: Your radio holds at most {{max}} contacts.
radio.advertIntervalHelp: In hours. 0 turns it off; 24 or more is recommended.
radio.sendAdvertHelp: Flood adverts go through repeaters. Zero-hop adverts stay local.
radio.meshDiscoveryHelp: Finds the repeaters and sensors around you.
radio.noNodesResponded: No supported nodes responded during the last discovery sweep.
radio.heardHere: Heard here: {{snr}} dB SNR / {{rssi}} dBm RSSI. Remote heard us: {{remote}} dB SNR.
radio.importKeyBody: This file changes your radio’s identity: other nodes will see a new device. You cannot undo it without the original key.
radio.geoUnsupportedHelp: Your browser does not support geolocation
radio.numericRequired: All numeric fields must have valid values
radio.clientRepeatDropped: Radio parameters saved without client repeat: this radio does not allow it on this frequency.
radio.regionsAlreadyListed: All discovered regions are already listed
radio.regionsAdded_one: Added {{count}} region — review and Save Messaging Settings
radio.regionsAdded_other: Added {{count}} regions — review and Save Messaging Settings
radio.exportWithKey: Export generated with the private key
radio.exportWithoutKey: Export generated without the private key
radio.exportWithoutKeyHelp: The radio did not give its private key (firmware without key export, or a proxy in between)
radio.invalidConfigHelp: File must contain name and radio parameters (freq, bw, sf, cr)
radio.importKeyRebooting: Config + private key imported, saving & rebooting...
radio.connectionChangeFailed: Failed to change radio connection state
radio.connectionChangeFailedHelp: Check radio connection and try again
radio.transportHelp: How Meshloom connects to this radio.
radio.blePinConfigured: A PIN is already saved. Leave blank to keep it.

blePairingState.notPaired: Not paired yet. Meshloom pairs with the saved PIN when it connects.
blePairingState.unknownDevice: This machine has not seen the radio yet. Check that it is on, in range, and not connected to a phone.
blePairingState.unsupported: Meshloom cannot pair by itself on this system. Pair the radio with the system’s Bluetooth tools.

radio.blePairingAutoBlocked: Automatic pairing is paused until you change the PIN or press Pair again.
radio.blePairingStaleBond: The radio keeps refusing the connection. If it was reset or re-flashed, press Forget pairing.
radio.bleForgetConfirm: Forget the pairing with this radio? Meshloom pairs again with the saved PIN at the next connection.
radio.blePairingSaveFirst: Save and connect first: pairing uses the saved address and PIN.
radio.unavailableUntilConnected: Radio identity and RF settings appear after the radio connects.
radio.identityMismatch: Identity mismatch — choose how to continue
radio.identityUnbound: Unbound historical radio — choose how to continue
radio.advancedIntro: Fixes for radios that misbehave. Leave them as they are unless Meshloom suggests one.
radio.advancedPollFallbackHelp: Turn this on if messages stay on the radio and never show up here. It keeps the radio a little busier.
radio.advancedForceSlot: Rewrite the channel before every send
radio.advancedForceSlotHelp: Turn this on if channel messages go out on the wrong channel. Each channel send takes a little longer.
radio.advancedAutoevict: Let the radio evict its oldest contacts
radio.advancedAutoevictHelp: When the radio’s contact list is full, it drops its oldest non-favorite contact. Turn this on if you see “contact table is full” errors.
radio.advancedClockWrap: Fix a radio clock stuck in the future
radio.advancedClockWrapHelp: Fixes a radio whose clock is stuck years in the future. Turn it off only if your board has a battery-backed clock.

radioApp.trackedRepeatersHelp: Repeaters whose telemetry Meshloom collects on its own. {{used}} / {{max}} tracked.
radioApp.alertRulesHelp: Alerts apply only to tracked nodes. A threshold is checked only when a poll returns a usable value.
radioApp.batteryVoltsMinHelp: Alert when reported battery is below this voltage.
radioApp.noiseFloorMaxHelp: Alert when reported noise floor is above this level.
radioApp.missesBeforeAlertHelp: Alert after this many polls with no usable reply. This is not a second hour setting.
radioApp.intervalClamped_one: Checking every {{effective}} hours instead of {{preferred}}, because {{tracked}} repeater is tracked.
radioApp.intervalClamped_other: Checking every {{effective}} hours instead of {{preferred}}, because {{tracked}} repeaters are tracked.
radioApp.pollRoutedHourlyHelp: Repeaters with a known route are checked every hour.
radioApp.nextFloodRun: Next flood run at {{time}} (UTC top of hour).
radioApp.nextRun: Next run at {{time}} (UTC top of hour).
radioApp.nextRoutedRun: Next direct/routed run at {{time}} (UTC top of hour).
radioApp.noRepeatersTracked: No repeaters are being tracked. Enable tracking from a repeater's dashboard.
radioApp.trackedContactsHelp: Other contacts (companions, rooms, sensors) whose telemetry Meshloom collects. Up to 8.
radioApp.noContactsTracked: No contacts are being tracked. Enable tracking from a contact's info pane.
radioApp.blockDiscovery: Block Discovery of New Node Types
radioApp.blockDiscoveryHelp: Ticked types are not added when Meshloom hears their advert. Existing contacts stay.
radioApp.blockedTypesWarn: New {{types}} heard via advertisement will not be added to your contact list.
radioApp.blockedContactsHelp: Blocked contacts and their messages are hidden. Unblock them to see their messages again.
radioApp.noBlocked: No blocked contacts. Block one from its info panel.
radioApp.bulkDeleteHelp: Remove several contacts or repeaters at once. Their messages are kept.

bulk.title: Bulk Delete Contacts
bulk.selectHelp: Select the contacts to delete. Their messages are kept.
bulk.confirmHelp: Review the contacts that will be permanently deleted.
bulk.noMatch: No contacts match the selected filters.
bulk.name: Name
bulk.confirmDelete: I confirm permanent, irrevocable deletion of all listed nodes above, totalling {{summary}}, spanning creation dates from {{minDate}} to {{maxDate}}

database.deleteUndecryptedHelp: Deletes the stored packets that could not be read. They are gone for good, even if you get the key later.
database.purgeArchivalHelp: Frees space by deleting the raw packets behind messages you can already read. Your messages stay.
database.autoDecrypt: Auto-decrypt historical DMs when new contact advertises
database.autoDecryptHelp: When a new contact appears, tries to read its stored direct messages.
database.invalidRetentionHelp: Retention days must be at least 1
database.purgeFailed: Failed to purge decrypted raw packets

stats.pathHashHelp: Parsed stored raw packets from the last 24 hours: {{count}}
stats.noPathData: No path data in the last 24 hours.
stats.regionScopeHelp: Share of local traffic sent to a region.
stats.floorNoise: This is within the margin of error (about {{floor}}).
stats.floorIncludes: About {{floor}} of these may be miscounted.
stats.noChannelMessages: No channel messages heard in the last 24 hours.
stats.oneNoiseSample: Only one sample so far ({{dbm}} dBm). The chart appears as more arrive.

community.intro: Optional: share what your radio hears on the Meshloom Community map. Enter your nearest airport code to join.
community.joinHelp: Save your nearest airport code to join. Nothing is shared before that.
community.bannerMessage: Enter your nearest airport code to use all Meshloom Community features.
community.bannerOptedOut: Meshloom Community is off. Join it to use all its features.

suggest.help: Sends your radio’s approximate position to Community, once.
suggest.none: No code to suggest: your radio has no position. Type the code yourself.
suggest.failed: Suggestions are not available right now. Type the code yourself.
suggest.title: Suggested codes: pick one, or type another.
suggest.both: used by your Community neighbours, and the nearest airport

community.disableHelp: Leaving stops sharing and turns off the features that rely on Community.
community.iataHelp: The 3-letter code of your nearest airport, such as CDG. It only names your region.
community.iataInvalid: IATA must be exactly 3 letters A–Z.
community.noIataPublishOff: No IATA code is saved, so publish stays off.
community.iataChangeCap: IATA change cap reached. Try again later.
community.joinIataChangeCap: This radio changed its code too often this week. Use your previous code or try again later.
community.overrideHelp: Keep this code even though it does not match your radio’s position.
community.concordanceOk: This IATA is consistent with your radio position.
community.concordanceWarn: This IATA is only loosely consistent with your radio position.
community.concordanceMismatch: This IATA is not consistent with your radio position.
community.concordanceUnknown: Cannot compare this IATA with your radio position yet.

waiting.banner: Meshloom Community needs your position to work
waiting.title: Community is waiting for your position
waiting.why: Community shows each radio on its map, so it needs your radio’s approximate position to start.
waiting.leaveHelp: If you would rather not give a position, you can leave Community.
waiting.positionSaved: Position saved and sent to Community. The banner goes away in a few seconds.
waiting.positionFailed: Could not save the position on the radio
waiting.settingsNote: Community is waiting for your radio’s position.
waiting.featureOff: This comes from Meshloom Community, which first needs your radio's position.
waiting.liveBanner: Community packets will show once your radio has a position.

optOut.title: Leave Meshloom Community?
optOut.intro: Meshloom stops sharing with Community, asks it to delete your radio’s position, and pauses Remote and sharing.
optOut.fullDeletion: To have everything deleted, write to <email>privacy@meshloom.app</email>.
optOut.notConfirmedToast: You left Community, but it did not confirm the deletion
optOut.pendingBody: Community did not confirm the deletion. Click Retry to send it again.

banned.title: Radio banned from Meshloom Community
banned.body: This radio can no longer use Community; the rest of Meshloom works as usual. If you think this is a mistake, write to <email>ban@meshloom.app</email>.

community.privacySummary: Your private messages stay encrypted. The docs list everything Community receives.

proxy.title: Radio Proxy
proxy.help: Lets a phone app or another Meshloom use this radio through Meshloom.
proxy.warning: There is no password: turn this on only on a network you trust.
proxy.identityHelp: Another Meshloom that connects here needs a new database.
proxy.portManagedByHost: Set by the host: change it in its network settings (in Home Assistant, the add-on’s Network panel).

about.kofi: This code is free, and ad-free, forever. If you love my work, <kofi>buy me a coffee!</kofi>

about.autoUpdateHelp: When a new release is published, Meshloom installs it on this node.

updates.nodeClockHelp: Times follow this node's clock, not this browser.
updates.legacyHelper: Run the Meshloom installer again on the host to switch to the signed update helper.

updates.helpApply: A newer Meshloom release is published. Install it on this node.
updates.autoUpdateHelp: When a new release is published, Meshloom installs it on this node.
updates.restartTimeout: The node did not come back with the new version.
